name: Raxio ET1 Data Centre
notes: Ethiopia's first carrier-neutral Tier III data centre in Ethio ICT Park, Addis Ababa. Operator datasheet: 2,000 sqm facility on 10,000 sqm compound, up to 800 racks and 3 MW IT power; DCD reported launch Nov 2023 after ground-breaking March 2021.

name: Wingu Africa Ethiopia Data Center ETH1
notes: Carrier-neutral hyperscale data center park at Ethio ICT Park, Addis Ababa on a 15,000 sqm plot; inaugurated June 2023 (USD 50m), first Ethiopian facility Tier III certified by Uptime Institute (2024); full build-out reported at 800 racks / 10 MW. Hosts ADDIX internet exchange. Operator also plans a second facility in Adama (Oromia).

name: Safaricom Ethiopia ICT Park data centre
developer: Safaricom Telecommunications Ethiopia PLC / Industrial Parks Development Corporation (IPDC)
notes: Safaricom signed a developed-land sub-lease with IPDC (Sep 2022) to build its third Ethiopian data centre in the ICT Park, described as a modern telco-cloud data centre supporting network rollout; build progress not fully public, kept as construction per operator announcement.

name: Safaricom Ethiopia Addis core prefabricated data centre (Kality)
notes: Prefabricated core data centre deployed for Safaricom Ethiopia's 2022 network launch; Addis Fortune reported a USD 100m facility assembled in China and shipped via Djibouti. Directory lists Safaricom Kality Data Centre at Kebele 43, Akaky Kaliti, Addis Ababa. Capacity not disclosed.

name: RedFox Modular Data Center 1 (RFETH-MDC01)
notes: Diaspora-owned RedFox launched its first local private modular data center at Ethio ICT Park (Sep 2022) at a reported cost of USD 130m; ENA (state wire) reported the operational launch and Ethiopian Business Review reports first client onboarding.

name: Ethio telecom Gola Sefer modular data center (Huawei)
notes: State telco Tier III-ready modular data centre launched May 2021 in Gola Sefer, Addis Ababa; Huawei-built, 5 PODs x 16 cabinets supporting up to 800 servers; operator signed DC-leasing agreements with five financial/ISP institutions (2022). Operator page (A) plus DCD/Addis Fortune/Monitor detail (B).

name: Ethio telecom Nefas Silk Data Center
notes: Uptime Institute lists Ethio telecom's Nefas Silk Data Center (Addis Ababa) with Tier III Certification of Design Documents; operational status and capacity not public.

name: Ethio telecom Old Airport Data Center
notes: Uptime Institute lists Ethio telecom's Old Airport Data Center (Addis Ababa) with Tier III Certification of Design Documents; operational status and capacity not public.

name: Ethio telecom Tikur Anbessa Data Center
notes: Uptime Institute lists Ethio telecom's Tikur Anbessa Data Center (Addis Ababa) with Tier III Certification of Design Documents; operational status and capacity not public.

name: Dashen Bank enterprise data center (Tier-III ready)
notes: Enterprise/self-use Tier-III-ready data center at Dashen Bank headquarters on Sudan Street, Addis Ababa; ~ETB 230m (USD 4.4m); Huawei FusionModule2000 platform; previous Wello Sefer DC kept as backup (Addis Fortune).

name: Zemen Bank ZBDCF01 Data Center
notes: Uptime Institute lists Zemen Bank ZBDCF01 (Addis Ababa) with Tier III Certification of Design Documents; operational details and capacity not public.

name: Ethiopian Government Tier III national data center
developer: Ministry of Innovation and Technology (MinT) / INSA
notes: Government-planned Tier III national data centre near Ethio ICT Park / Bole Lemi Industrial Park for government workloads and cloud/colocation; World Bank referenced planned green data center investment. Programme-level evidence; physical completion not confirmed.

name: RailTel Ethiopia Ministry of Foreign Affairs greenfield data centre
developer: RailTel Corporation of India / Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Ethiopia
notes: RailTel reported to have secured a greenfield data centre project for Ethiopia's Ministry of Foreign Affairs in Addis Ababa; completion targeted within one year plus three years O&M; capacity not disclosed.

name: Phoenix Group Bole Lemi data mining facility (hydropower-backed)
notes: Phoenix Group signed an 80 MW PPA in Ethiopia (Reuters, Jan 2025), added 52 MW (Apr 2025) and launched a 30 MW hydropower-backed mining/compute facility at Bole Lemi Industrial Park, Addis Ababa with EEP (Nov 2025; 6,250 sqm purpose-built site). Operator+site+MW named by reputable press = B; EEP primary record would upgrade to A.

name: Ethio telecom Debre Birhan Data Center DC01
notes: Uptime Institute lists Ethio telecom's Debre Birhan Data Center DC01 (Amhara/Amara) with Tier III Certification of Design Documents; capacity and operational state not public.

name: Commercial Bank of Ethiopia CBE-FI Data Center Phase 1 (Debre Berhan)
notes: Uptime Tier IV design-certified CBE-FI Data Center Phase 1 in Debre Berhan; CBE tender documents reference the Debre-Berhan Tier IV Data Center Construction Project Phase I. Design certification only; construction/operation unverified this pass.

name: BIT Mining Ethiopian crypto mining data centers
notes: BIT Mining announced acquisition of 51 MW of Ethiopian crypto mining data centers (35 MW electrified in phase one). Press does not name the region; Benshangul-Gumuz assignment rests on weak social reporting - keep C until an EEP/ECA/operator primary record names the site.

name: Safaricom Ethiopia Dire Dawa data centre (planned)
notes: Safaricom Ethiopia stated it would develop similar data centre infrastructure in Adama and Dire Dawa after the Addis core DC; no operator/ECA/power record of a completed Dire Dawa facility found - planned lead.

name: Dire Dawa University modular data center infrastructure
notes: IE Networks case study reports successful implementation of modular data center infrastructure for Dire Dawa University (project size 54M ETB); institutional-scale facility.

name: Bitdeer Oromia Region bitcoin mining data center
notes: Bitdeer SEC filing: Oromia Region 50 MW Bitcoin mining project, construction completed with 40 MW online (Oct 2025) and remaining 10 MW energization planned Dec 2025; Bitdeer acquired the local mining partner for USD 7.5m incl. 4-year PPA at $0.036/kWh. SEC filing = A primary evidence.

name: Geek Zone Data Center PLC Holeta mining farm
notes: Bitdeer marketplace page lists Geek Zone Data Center PLC in Holeta, Oromia, powered on Jan 2024 with a 70 MW mining-farm load and direct grid power agreement; directories also list a Bitdeer Oromia site near Bobe/Holeta (GERD hydropower).

name: Wingu Africa Adama data center (planned second facility)
notes: Wingu.Africa repeatedly stated a second planned facility in Adama City (Oromia, ~96 km SE of Addis); no construction or permit evidence found - planned lead.

name: Safaricom Ethiopia Adama data centre (planned)
notes: Safaricom Ethiopia announced post-Addis data centre development in Adama; no official/ECA/power record of completion found - planned lead.

name: Kabridahar University Standardised Data Centre
notes: Kabridahar University ICT Directorate (Somali Regional State) administers a standardized data centre with fiber backbone and campus LAN; institutional scale, no capacity disclosed.

name: Jigjiga University Data Center
notes: Jigjiga University ICT page refers to university rules for hosting software in the university Data Center, indicating an operational institutional data center; no capacity details.

name: Jigjiga University modular data center infrastructure tender
notes: Tender aggregators report Jigjiga University notice JJU/NCB/013/2015 E.C. for turnkey modular data center infrastructure (2023); award/completion unconfirmed - C-grade lead.

name: Mizan Tepi University Data Center Environment
developer: Mizan Tepi University; IE Network Solutions
notes: IE Network Solutions delivered supply/installation/commissioning of a Data Center Environment for Mizan Tepi University (>45M ETB); later support/maintenance tenders indicate the centre remained in service.

name: Bonga University Data Center Power Facility
notes: 2026 eGP-sourced tender by Bonga University for corrective/preventive maintenance of a data center power facility supports an operational institutional data center in the South West Ethiopia region; no capacity data.

name: Mekelle University Tier-III Data Center
notes: Mekelle University ICT Directorate describes six campuses interconnected via fiber and a Tier-III Data Center operated by the directorate (Tigray); no power capacity disclosed.

name: Adigrat University Main Data Center IDS2000-M
notes: Adigrat University ICT page says its ICT modernization centers on the Main Data Center IDS2000-M with integrated IT/power/cooling, smart monitoring, hybrid grid/diesel/solar backup and NOC; no MW disclosed.

name: Mekelle University Software-Defined Data Center tender
notes: Mekelle University tender ICB 001/2013 E.C./LOT 1 for a Software-Defined Data Center (2021); award/completion and capacity unconfirmed - C-grade lead.

name: ECA Data Center/Hosting Service Provider licensing regime
notes: Regulatory context (not a physical facility): ECA services page and Telecommunications Licensing Directive No. 792/2021 define Data Center Service Provider License and Hosting Service Provider License categories - the official licensing route for Ethiopian colo/hosting operators.
